title: The Headlands and the emotional reality of Ukrainian farming games
summary: Short SSI contextual post fixture linking The Headlands to how agricultural work and emotional strain are represented publicly.

payload.excerpt: Fixture for a short SSI contextual post about The Headlands and why public representations of Ukrainian farming life matter.
body_lines: The Headlands is not a market report, but it is still relevant to agricultural infrastructure.
Games and cultural projects can surface the emotional weight, uncertainty and physical routine behind farming in a way that spreadsheets cannot.
For SSI, that makes it a useful contextual reference: price infrastructure exists around real people, real land and real operational pressure.
